intro: Highway 1 between Monterey and San Simeon is a radio dead zone by design — almost no cell service, very few repeaters, and long stretches where the only things on the air are the marine channels, NOAA, and whatever bounces in from a hilltop. Bring the marine band and low expectations, and it becomes one of the more memorable places to listen.
introz: 蒙特雷到圣西蒙之间的 1 号公路本身就是无线电空白区——几乎没有手机信号，中继稀少，很长的路段里空中只有海事频道、NOAA，以及从山头偶然折射过来的信号。带上海事波段、放低期待，这里会成为最难忘的收听地点之一。

stations.d: Sits in a bowl that fills with marine layer most mornings — lots of instrument approaches and diversions to listen to.
stations.dz: 机场处在一个盆地里，多数早晨都被海雾填满——能听到很多仪表进近和备降。

stations.d: Agricultural aviation hub. Crop-dusting and fire-tanker activity in season.
stations.dz: 农业航空中心。季节性有喷洒作业和消防灭火机活动。

stations.z: 圣路易斯奥比斯波塔台

stations.d: Along Big Sur there is no tower for a hundred miles. Air-to-air and Oakland Center high-altitude sectors are most of what you will hear.
stations.dz: 大苏尔沿线上百英里没有塔台。能听到的主要是空空通话和奥克兰高空管制扇区。

stations.z: 奥克兰区域管制（沿海扇区）
stations.d: Enroute control for traffic tracking down the coast. Reception is best from the ridgetops, not the beach.
stations.dz: 沿海岸南下航班的区域管制。在山脊上比在海滩上收得好。

stations.d: Coastal and offshore waters forecast. Essential if you are anywhere near the surf.
stations.dz: 近岸与近海海况预报。只要靠近浪区就必备。

stations.z: NOAA 圣路易斯奥比斯波区

stations.d: Whale-watch boats, kayak outfitters, research vessels and the Coast Guard. The most reliably active thing on the Central Coast.
stations.dz: 观鲸船、皮划艇租赁、科考船和海警。中加州海岸最稳定活跃的频道。

stations.d: Safety broadcasts, and search-and-rescue coordination when it happens.
stations.dz: 安全通告，以及搜救行动时的协调。

stations.z: 海事 09 频道 · 呼叫
海事 72 频道 · 船间
stations.d: Where the whale-watching skippers tell each other where the whales actually are.
stations.dz: 观鲸船长互相通报鲸鱼实际位置的地方。

stations.d: In Big Sur, simplex from a ridge is more likely to work than any repeater. Try from Nacimiento-Fergusson Road or the Cone Peak area.
stations.dz: 在大苏尔，山脊直通比任何中继都靠谱。可在 Nacimiento-Fergusson 路或 Cone Peak 一带试。

stations.d: Coverage on the Central Coast is thin and repeaters change. Check RepeaterBook for Monterey and San Luis Obispo counties before you go.
stations.dz: 中加州海岸中继覆盖稀疏且常有变动。出发前请在 RepeaterBook 查蒙特雷县和圣路易斯奥比斯波县。

stations.d: Forest Service operations along the Big Sur backcountry. Scan 168–173 MHz too — federal fire nets live there.
stations.dz: 大苏尔腹地的林务局作业。也扫一下 168–173 MHz，联邦消防网在那一段。

stations.d: Big Sur burns often. When it does, this frequency comes alive with air-attack coordination.
stations.dz: 大苏尔常有火情。一旦起火，这个频率会因空中攻击协调而热闹起来。

stations.d: Condor tracking crews at Pinnacles use radio telemetry as well as voice.
stations.dz: Pinnacles 的加州神鹫追踪队除语音外还使用无线电遥测。

stations.z: KAZU 太平洋丛林市公共广播
stations.d: Monterey Bay's NPR outlet. Reaches surprisingly far down the coast.
stations.dz: 蒙特雷湾的 NPR 台，沿海岸南下覆盖意外地远。

stations.d: A genuine institution — Americana, roots and live-in-studio sessions, run with real personality since the seventies. Arguably the reason to drive Highway 1 with the radio on.
stations.dz: 一家真正的传奇电台——美式根源音乐、现场棚内演出，从七十年代起就充满个性。可以说是开着 1 号公路一路听广播的理由。

stations.z: KCBX 圣路易斯奥比斯波公共广播
KCPR 加州理工州立大学
stations.d: Long-running student freeform station in San Luis Obispo.
stations.dz: 圣路易斯奥比斯波历史悠久的学生自由形式电台。

stations.z: KCSB 加州大学圣芭芭拉台
KZSC 加州大学圣克鲁兹台

stations.d: The Coast Starlight runs this route. Scan 160.215–161.565 near the tracks in Salinas, Paso Robles or Santa Barbara.
stations.dz: Coast Starlight 号走这条线。在萨利纳斯、帕索罗布尔斯或圣芭芭拉靠近轨道时扫 160.215–161.565。

stations.d: Big Sur at night with no cell service and no light pollution is an excellent place to tune HF and hear things that make no sense.
stations.dz: 深夜的大苏尔没有手机信号也没有光污染，非常适合调短波，听一些完全无法理解的东西。

stations.d: Clear ocean horizon to the west makes coastal ridges good for satellite passes.
stations.dz: 西面是开阔的海平线，沿海山脊很适合接收卫星过顶。
